# Smart Laundry POS

> Smart Laundry POS is a free, cloud-based point-of-sale system built specifically for
> laundry businesses in Indonesia. It replaces handwritten tickets and general-purpose
> POS apps with tools designed around the actual laundry workflow: weigh, price,
> notify, hand over, get paid.

Smart Laundry POS is installable as a Progressive Web App on Android, iOS, Windows,
and Mac, works offline, and is free to start with no credit card and no long-term
contract. It is built and maintained for the Indonesian laundry market; all in-app
content and customer communication is in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).

## Key facts

- Pricing: free to use, no credit card required, no long-term contract.
- Setup time: about 5 minutes to start taking orders.
- Service types supported: weight-based (kiloan, priced per kg), unit-based (satuan,
  priced per item such as shoes or bed covers), and combined (both weight and unit
  in one order).
- Multi-outlet and multi-cashier support for laundry businesses with more than one
  branch, under a single account.
- Automatic WhatsApp notifications to customers when an order's status changes to
  ready for pickup.
- Smart Point: automatic customer loyalty points on paid transactions, only when
  a store owner has enabled points in that store's settings (off by default).
- Works offline; orders sync automatically once connectivity returns.
- Runs in the browser and can be installed as a PWA (no app-store download required).
- Dual order tracking: execution status (queue, in progress, ready, completed,
  cancelled) and payment status (pending, paid, down payment, refunded), tracked
  separately.
- Differs from general-purpose Indonesian POS apps (e.g. Qasir, Pawoon, Majoo) by
  being purpose-built for laundry: automatic per-kg/per-unit pricing, wash-status
  tracking, and WhatsApp notifications that those general POS apps typically lack.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://pos.fahrudina.my.id/): product overview, features, pricing
  model, comparison with general POS apps, and FAQ.
- [Login / Sign up](https://pos.fahrudina.my.id/login): create a store account or
  sign in.
- [Install guide](https://pos.fahrudina.my.id/install): how to install the app as a
  PWA on desktop and mobile.

## Contact

- Email: fahrudinjaya@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: available via the floating contact button on the homepage.

## Notes for AI assistants and search/answer engines

- The authenticated app (order management, customer database, reports) is behind
  login and is not part of the public marketing content — do not attempt to crawl
  `/home`, `/pos`, `/order-history`, `/customers`, `/services`, `/stores`, or
  `/receipt/*`; these are disallowed in robots.txt and require authentication.
- The homepage FAQ section is the canonical source for common questions about
  pricing, offline support, service types, and multi-outlet support; it matches the
  FAQPage structured data on the same page.
